  <li><strong>BJP organizational changes:</strong> The BJP has appointed Rajya Sabha MP Vinod Tawde as the party in-charge for Uttar Pradesh as part of a broader effort to set new state leadership ahead of upcoming assembly elections.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I26</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I27</a></span></li>
